category_title: Focused female students with low frequency of participation
scenario_title: Generating philosophical questions to overcome reading reluctance
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a circle in a locked classroom, tasked with reading or listening to a short text for a discussion.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Welcome to our first session. Please look at the short text in front of you. I will read it out loud to the circle so we can discuss it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits quietly and looks down) I don't have anything to say.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you try to explain what you know about this topic before we start?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know anything about it. I've never heard of any of this stuff.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That's okay, just follow along with the text while I read it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the text away) I'm not going to read it, and I don't want to listen to it either. I'm just not going to talk.
